languages.title: Your languages

groceryNames.label: Grocery names

languages.abroad: Shopping abroad? Set Receipts & labels to that country's language. You can change all of these later in Settings.

setup.title: Fill your Pantry with Gator?
setup.body: Two quick tries and your kitchen is already in the app. About two minutes.
setup.skip: Skip, take me to the app
setup.languagesNotSaved: We couldn't save your languages. You chose {{choices}}. You can set them again in Settings.

setupStep.lostPhotos_one: Skip and lose this photo? It hasn't been saved yet.
setupStep.lostPhotos_other: Skip and lose these {{count}} photos? They haven't been saved yet.
setupStep.lostNotes_one: Skip and lose this note? It hasn't been applied yet.
setupStep.lostNotes_other: Skip and lose these {{count}} notes? They haven't been applied yet.

bubble.ingredients: Put some food on the counter and snap it. Take as many photos as you like and I'll work out what it all is.
bubble.receipt: Snap the receipt from your last shop. A long one? Take it in a few photos and I'll put the whole shop away.

ingredients.label: Ingredients
ingredients.hint: Fruit, veg, packets and tins on the counter

receipt.label: Receipt
receipt.hint: The receipt from your last shop, laid flat

callout.title: Tap the camera and snap away
callout.body: Take as many photos as you need. The camera is always here, in the middle of the menu

sayIt.bubble: Now just tell me what's in the cupboard, or what to buy. Leave as many notes as you like.

pantry.phrase: “We have rice and two tins of tomatoes”

shopping.result: Adds it to the Shopping List

callout.title: Hold the mic, talk, let go
callout.body: Your phone will ask for the microphone. Leave a few notes if you like, then review them together. Each recording is deleted once I've read it.

noVoice.bubble: Voice Notes aren't switched on here, so we'll skip this one.
noVoice.callout: Voice Notes need the server to be set up for them. You can add things by hand in the app.

heard.title: Here's what I heard
heard.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you say so. Tap a line to change it.

review.bannerCheck_one: Check the one I wasn't sure about. Tap any line to fix it.
review.bannerCheck_other: Check the {{count}} I wasn't sure about. Tap any line to fix it.
review.bannerClear_one: Nothing I wasn't sure about. Tap the line to fix it.
review.bannerClear_other: Nothing I wasn't sure about. Tap any line to fix it.

allSet.bubble: You're all set! I'll keep an eye on your kitchen.
allSet.tipReceipt: After each shop, snap the receipt. It ticks off your list too.
allSet.tipMic: The camera and mic are always in the middle of the menu.
allSet.error: We couldn't finish just now. Try again.
